KittenTTS Mini 0.8
Model: https://huggingface.co/KittenML/kitten-tts-mini-0.8
Pinned model revision: c02725660cea441db4c383af69f1f26f5cd00947
Code: https://github.com/KittenML/KittenTTS
Reference code revision: f0282f0198d497b7256535b755f9f3e339c1baa7 (0.8.1)
License: Apache License 2.0 (included as LICENSE).

QuietSelection's kitten_engine.py adapts the upstream token inventory, token
spacing, model inputs, style index and output padding. Changes: private bounded
IPC; existing native eSpeak bridge; existing English number normalizer; bounded,
lossless text segmentation; cancellation and CPU limits; no source-text logging,
network access, Hugging Face client or audio files during inference.

The weights and eight speaker profiles are separate local model data, verified
by the hashes in kitten-models.json. They are not bundled inside the MSIX.
ONNX Runtime, NumPy and eSpeak are already included with the application's
existing speech runtime; their own licenses remain in third-party/piper.
